I FALL INTO DISGRACE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u006-b0116", "target": "Длину тех пяти дней я не могу никому передать. В моей памяти они занимают место лет. То, как я прислушивался ко всему, что происходило в доме и достигало моего слуха: звон колокольчиков, открывание и закрывание дверей, бормотание голосов, шаги на лестнице; любой смех, свист или пение снаружи, которые казались мне унылее всего остального в моём одиночестве и позоре; неверный ход часов, особенно ночью, когда я просыпался, думая, что уже утро, и обнаруживал, что семья ещё не легла и что вся длина ночи ещё впереди; угнетённые сны и кошмары; возвращение дня, полдень, послеобеденное время, вечер, когда мальчишки играли на церковном дворе, а я смотрел на них издали из комнаты, стыдясь показаться в окне, чтобы они не узнали, что я узник; странное ощущение, что я ни разу не слышу собственного голоса; мимолётные промежутки чего-то похожего на бодрость, которые приходили вместе с едой и питьём и уходили вместе с ними; наступление дождя одним вечером, со свежим запахом, и то, как он лил всё сильнее и сильнее между мной и церковью, пока он и сгущавшаяся ночь не погасили меня в мраке, страхе и раскаянии, — всё это, кажется, кружилось и кружилось годами, а не днями, так ярко и сильно оно запечатлелось в моей памяти. В последнюю ночь моего заключения я проснулся оттого, что услышал своё имя, произнесённое шёпотом. Я вскочил в постели и, протянув руки в темноту, сказал:", "source_sha256": "1504559f0694e62e6a0cf8cbbc3b255ec9eb659c67f0e5bda79b01f2181b73d8", "target_id": "ru-en85-u006-b0116", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3476905b24f3cc6563f61fb01604b2e225fca4bc817e0a990051bc321c5d9670"}, {"source_id": "en85-u006-b0117", "target": "— Это ты, Пегготи?", "source_sha256": "6e86337c1b3c1addbc583ff91555eb7a7d5e184138b064015c6fed3dd7edd5be", "target_id": "ru-en85-u006-b0117", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a0c1770063b6e2fa8290967b1c0b33d7f4e378d882713a3acb385da64a52dc8a"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 4, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u006-b0118", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "There was no immediate answer, but presently I heard my name again, in a tone so very mysterious and awful, that I think I should have gone into a fit, if it had not occurred to me that it must have come through the keyhole.", "sha256": "8b2c1b0a81ab623393403268cfc7e4bc3a8dafc3b7e536335231767744621d06", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[118]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0119", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I groped my way to the door, and putting my own lips to the keyhole, whispered: ‘Is that you, Peggotty dear?’", "sha256": "11614a911ad495d5751fe540e182e60886943cec7bd4a69a8de4a8a6ca64207a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[119]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0120", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, my own precious Davy,’ she replied. ‘Be as soft as a mouse, or the Cat’ll hear us.’", "sha256": "8f1c8c963fefffd0bbd66bc6e898143e03f8df6f7caa74541ccb562cda8644a8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[120]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0121", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I understood this to mean Miss Murdstone, and was sensible of the urgency of the case; her room being close by.", "sha256": "e86d3aca6aa0584bc7a8b9e7e37c9c2f813c25432cdda51d710cd1aaeff2db06", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[121]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0122", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘How’s mama, dear Peggotty? Is she very angry with me?’", "sha256": "e55631b3c62a82e724ce3069259c9e8541e4b28464859c3f49abe20e2e6322aa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[122]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0123", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I could hear Peggotty crying softly on her side of the keyhole, as I was doing on mine, before she answered. ‘No. Not very.’", "sha256": "17e09d96ffd2bde58a81c9ae8cb84be5507de05e187ef616103ffa427eed5e6a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[123]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0124", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What is going to be done with me, Peggotty dear? Do you know?’", "sha256": "0eeceb8c5f6b471d53ae9fcc2502f360a25877bbb188edad10983895c8367936", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[124]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0125", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘School. Near London,’ was Peggotty’s answer. I was obliged to get her to repeat it, for she spoke it the first time quite down my throat, in consequence of my having forgotten to take my mouth away from the keyhole and put my ear there; and though her words tickled me a good deal, I didn’t hear them.", "sha256": "e81001a0dd107a894534438e34d29a90d2683b5a6271bc0ebaa2341b63c88208", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[125]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0126", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘When, Peggotty?’", "sha256": "688d2b174f8dfa3533dc6bffb6df26c67b61e098b908162927deca5bc54c6ffa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[126]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0127", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Tomorrow.’", "sha256": "11344c7bb815d07da67263490d14f7237b33348b64774515a3cd3b5b94e71593", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[127]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0128", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is that the reason why Miss Murdstone took the clothes out of my drawers?’ which she had done, though I have forgotten to mention it.", "sha256": "eb266e656c9a307ea9bb589c50a2181acbfec2d3f647fb408792991c051368de", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[128]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0129", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes,’ said Peggotty. ‘Box.’", "sha256": "4cc386c0bc6cee7e1ac40423f547a50ee469353cc9238a8a07892a49f5667715", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[129]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0130", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Shan’t I see mama?’", "sha256": "c86cb0ff0110252365bfd78452e1d6e7c8770c1c87ec51dff1a01f33ed126a40", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[130]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0131", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes,’ said Peggotty. ‘Morning.’", "sha256": "a54ca4dfc7cf7dbe2d52dcab01eca0ce4c34df9870047a84f9f298998888640a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[131]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0132", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Then Peggotty fitted her mouth close to the keyhole, and delivered these words through it with as much feeling and earnestness as a keyhole has ever been the medium of communicating, I will venture to assert: shooting in each broken little sentence in a convulsive little burst of its own.", "sha256": "c4d865e55ece3555ed12bd59888a37ff2284f460fca72d0c46e2c435522754c2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[132]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0133", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Davy, dear. If I ain’t been azackly as intimate with you. Lately, as I used to be. It ain’t because I don’t love you. Just as well and more, my pretty poppet. It’s because I thought it better for you. And for someone else besides. Davy, my darling, are you listening? Can you hear?’", "sha256": "2d896cd3954155747c0365fc4dd0167f7aade9ccfee53fa9c41a25a228b1e551", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[133]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0134", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ye-ye-ye-yes, Peggotty!’ I sobbed.", "sha256": "fd1fcd3808c70db44fd058108052d405f3807e0f4e0bd7d68dc17cf8bf1858c0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[134]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0135", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My own!’ said Peggotty, with infinite compassion. ‘What I want to say, is. That you must never forget me. For I’ll never forget you. And I’ll take as much care of your mama, Davy. As ever I took of you. And I won’t leave her. The day may come when she’ll be glad to lay her poor head. On her stupid, cross old Peggotty’s arm again. And I’ll write to you, my dear. Though I ain’t no scholar. And I’ll—I’ll—’ Peggotty fell to kissing the keyhole, as she couldn’t kiss me.", "sha256": "da4320dfa11c3d68f3077759a2bce6ac4f8bc7c736bf9866fce0b632594931cb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[135]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0136", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Thank you, dear Peggotty!’ said I. ‘Oh, thank you! Thank you! Will you promise me one thing, Peggotty? Will you write and tell Mr. Peggotty and little Em’ly, and Mrs. Gummidge and Ham, that I am not so bad as they might suppose, and that I sent ‘em all my love—especially to little Em’ly? Will you, if you please, Peggotty?’", "sha256": "84c8e6f174a4d76c24acd757858e917afa613c70620ccd6d05d3a70299de3c50", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[136]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The kind soul promised, and we both of us kissed the keyhole with the greatest affection—I patted it with my hand, I recollect, as if it had been her honest face—and parted. From that night there grew up in my breast a feeling for Peggotty which I cannot very well define. She did not replace my mother; no one could do that; but she came into a vacancy in my heart, which closed upon her, and I felt towards her something I have never felt for any other human being. It was a sort of comical affection, too; and yet if she had died, I cannot think what I should have done, or how I should have acted out the tragedy it would have been to me.", "sha256": "4c189712790ec3d9d53b217b6aa7ce8fff0c6ba459b5d934a762364bdcbb7432", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0138", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In the morning Miss Murdstone appeared as usual, and told me I was going to school; which was not altogether such news to me as she supposed. She also informed me that when I was dressed, I was to come downstairs into the parlour, and have my breakfast. There, I found my mother, very pale and with red eyes: into whose arms I ran, and begged her pardon from my suffering soul.", "sha256": "e33e3ccc74a0abeaf0c586701bf75966d419299bec0f1460fe875853b7d8d55c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[138]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, Davy!’ she said. ‘That you could hurt anyone I love! Try to be better, pray to be better! I forgive you; but I am so grieved, Davy, that you should have such bad passions in your heart.’", "sha256": "8a7ffe53e0c4bc8544662dd11a12102d71937a1d01ae8901c5ba349bfb5e2a52", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0140", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "They had persuaded her that I was a wicked fellow, and she was more sorry for that than for my going away. I felt it sorely. I tried to eat my parting breakfast, but my tears dropped upon my bread-and-butter, and trickled into my tea. I saw my mother look at me sometimes, and then glance at the watchful Miss Murdstone, and than look down, or look away.", "sha256": "7a693e4e30a8d3a299016c7257561ae81eee4d7fc651295838e703fbf29d7b95", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[140]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0141", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Master Copperfield’s box there!’ said Miss Murdstone, when wheels were heard at the gate.", "sha256": "e871ce82055fa73f1917b97891a3fab2a713ce66db6616448b5f9ae3d0d653b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[141]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0142", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I looked for Peggotty, but it was not she; neither she nor Mr. Murdstone appeared. My former acquaintance, the carrier, was at the door. The box was taken out to his cart, and lifted in.", "sha256": "d2e3faadbc0e47a61705b200366f941e8a7881a5753e092e4c5b3ea57c842300", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[142]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0143", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Clara!’ said Miss Murdstone, in her warning note.", "sha256": "58a34c9612a9d96eda80fdbe44cadc7ac9ffa9a3ba12c7016e98642fbc656452", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[143]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0144", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ready, my dear Jane,’ returned my mother. ‘Good-bye, Davy. You are going for your own good. Good-bye, my child. You will come home in the holidays, and be a better boy.’", "sha256": "36c1d8d2f562e2372cca290879f878456536c824956d4122b4b2b9e3e98aaf09", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[144]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0145", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Clara!’ Miss Murdstone repeated.", "sha256": "c4ecf368faefdc5e3199694738e87ea212baf49eff57987311d3fe506e242ffb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[145]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0146", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Certainly, my dear Jane,’ replied my mother, who was holding me. ‘I forgive you, my dear boy. God bless you!’", "sha256": "7240000aa1bb6d7d24a1e0ead36807c593ea4e1bdd5163b9726004bd69ff4c69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[146]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0147", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Clara!’ Miss Murdstone repeated.", "sha256": "c4ecf368faefdc5e3199694738e87ea212baf49eff57987311d3fe506e242ffb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[147]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u006-b0148", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Miss Murdstone was good enough to take me out to the cart, and to say on the way that she hoped I would repent, before I came to a bad end; and then I got into the cart, and the lazy horse walked off with it.", "sha256": "1c9610964c2c0e5bb1a5a186ce3428fc429b00539a9bdbb229c76c9651fe8e09", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[11]/p[148]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
